## [1.20.0](https://github.com/JacksonJones2003/immersive-keyboard-patches/compare/v1.19.0...v1.20.0) (2026-10-28)

### ✨ New Features

* Pick light and dark mode wallpapers in vivo Themes itself ([9a3c627](https://github.com/JacksonJones2003/immersive-keyboard-patches/commit/9a3c627e9b354a4d0bc4a30cd4418f3615dfe8d3))

patches.name: Emoji Key On Right
patches.description: Moves the dedicated emoji key from the left of the spacebar to just left of the enter / search key.

patches.name: Glass Panel
patches.description: Turns the translucent keyboard panel into glass. On vivo OriginOS it uses the system's own glass material, with real refraction, rim light and dispersion; elsewhere it draws lit edges and a sheen. Keys are left as they are. Works on top of Translucent Bottom Bar and Frosted Glass. Floating popups, like the keyboard switcher shown with a hardware keyboard, get the same glass.

patches.name: Glass Press Effect
patches.description: Adds vivo-style liquid glass touch feedback: a soft light blooms out from your finger across the keyboard background, and the keys around your finger dip and spring back with a small wobble while the rest of the keyboard stays still. When glide typing, the dip follows your finger. Floating popups light up the same way.

patches.name: Immersive Keyboard
patches.description: Extends the keyboard under the camera cutout in landscape instead of leaving an empty strip beside it.

patches.name: Theme Follows Dark Mode
patches.description: Adds a "Light & dark pair" menu to the top of Gboard's Themes screen. Choose a theme for light mode and one for dark mode, and the keyboard switches between them when the system dark mode changes. It can switch the wallpaper between a light and a dark image too.

patches.name: Translucent Bottom Bar
patches.description: Makes the bar under the keyboard (behind the globe and close buttons) match the keyboard's color, opacity and blur, for use with transparent themes such as Frosted Glass.
